assertions.description: 三单在同一趟旅程里，任务类型各自保留：受理行的 WorkType 是各自的类型，冻结的卸货站是各自类型绑定的站；库里只有一条旅程
本趟两次追加都发生在停站窗口内（不证行驶中拒绝）：乙在车停于 12 号站（甲装完之后、离站订单之前）加入，丙在车停于 11 号站（乙装完之后、离站订单之前）加入；加入那一刻旅程停在站上、当前停靠就是那一站
assertions.expected: B at station 12, C at station 11: loaded <= joined < next departure order; AwaitingStationDeparture
assertions.actual: B: A loaded 12:29:58.812 <= joined 12:30:01.801 < next departure order 12:30:10.631; stage AwaitingStationDeparture, current stop journey:cbdad0ce-8051-48d0-8571-0de02867e39e|PICKUP@12 | C: B loaded 12:30:12.600 <= joined 12:30:14.696 < next departure order 12:30:24.652; stage AwaitingStationDeparture, current stop journey:ba822a29-7b14-4602-ab3f-1333f81eec87|PICKUP@11

assertions.description: 计划里有三个不同的卸货停靠，站号各不相同，各是对应那一单的卸货停靠、落在该单类型绑定的站
三单装进不同仓位，各在自己 AREA 指派的那一组（甲 N1-3、丙 N1-7 指 FRONT，乙 C15-13 指 REAR）
assertions.expected: A FRONT, B REAR, C FRONT; three distinct slots
assertions.actual: A [1] FRONT; B [5] REAR; C [2] FRONT

assertions.description: 卸货站 305（第 1 个卸货停靠）卸的正是 C（WIRE_TO_NITROGEN）装上车的那些仓：LOAD 命令、Load 提交、UNLOAD 命令、Unload 提交的仓位都等于它的目标仓，别的单在这一站没有新的卸货命令
assertions.expected: LOAD [2]; UNLOAD [2]; Load op [2]; Unload op [2]; others +0
assertions.actual: LOAD [2]; UNLOAD [2]; Load op [2]; Unload op [2]; A+0 B+0

assertions.description: 卸货站 13（第 2 个卸货停靠）卸的正是 B（WIRE_TO_OPTICAL）装上车的那些仓：LOAD 命令、Load 提交、UNLOAD 命令、Unload 提交的仓位都等于它的目标仓，别的单在这一站没有新的卸货命令
assertions.expected: LOAD [5]; UNLOAD [5]; Load op [5]; Unload op [5]; others +0
assertions.actual: LOAD [5]; UNLOAD [5]; Load op [5]; Unload op [5]; A+0 C+0

assertions.description: 卸货站 210（第 3 个卸货停靠）卸的正是 A（WIRE_TO_GATE）装上车的那些仓：LOAD 命令、Load 提交、UNLOAD 命令、Unload 提交的仓位都等于它的目标仓，别的单在这一站没有新的卸货命令
assertions.expected: LOAD [1]; UNLOAD [1]; Load op [1]; Unload op [1]; others +0
assertions.actual: LOAD [1]; UNLOAD [1]; Load op [1]; Unload op [1]; B+0 C+0

assertions.description: 旅程 Completed，三单的受理行都是 Succeeded
两次追加记下的每区参数版本都是 setup 写入的那一版，那一版里 MAP-25-WIRE_TO_GATE 的上限是 50000
上限 30000 时，车停在 12 号站载着丁，戊（同乙的形状，要 40000）的追加被拒：积压原因 EN_ROUTE_APPEND_DELAY_GATE_EXCEEDED，没有受理、没进丁的旅程
assertions.expected: EN_ROUTE_APPEND_DELAY_GATE_EXCEEDED / not accepted / 0 memberships / D at station
assertions.actual: EN_ROUTE_APPEND_DELAY_GATE_EXCEEDED / not accepted / 0 memberships / D AwaitingStationDeparture
